comparison.objective: Seat a hose camlock coupler on a tank adapter and close both cam arms; the candidate sets and jam-nut-locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Close-clearance axial coupling followed by two cam-lever closures, not concentric screw/nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Coupler must be seated within 1 mm and both cam arms closed; candidate requires a target angle preserved through repeated jaw cycles.
comparison.reason: Both lock industrial hardware, but cam-and-groove connection tests insertion and lever closure rather than adjustment preservation.
